source: PREREG_V3_FROZEN.md §V3.1-§V3.2b. v2 rules with the v3 hit definition and the v3.1 rank design. Mechanical transcription; the document wins.
primary: p0 = (1 + #{control-2 bases b with p_self(b) <= p_self(phi)}) / 301; p_self of phi and of every null base with M = 200, M' = 999, w = 0.10, v3 hit; ties against phi
non_confirmatory: v2 is a re-analysis of public data (statistic chosen after v1 results were public); any POSITIVE must carry that sentence

POSITIVE.condition: p0 <= 0.01 AND at least 2 of [V4, V8_1e-3, w003] give p <= 0.05 (each p = phi rank among 100 random bases scored identically under the variant) AND all validity controls pass

sub_label.ROBUST: V2 and V6 both give p > 0.10

NEGATIVE.mandatory_scope: excludes, at power >= 0.8, an effect in which phi hits at least 6 of the 8 informative rows through a real effect; weaker effects are not excluded

INVALID_if_any: v1 or v3 bundle hash mismatch
any rule, seed, dither law or size changed after freeze
control 3(b) paired: two-sample KS between phi randomised p_self on 100 scrambles and a random base on each same scramble (same dithers) <= 0.01
any evaluation of any base on the real targets before freeze
UNDERPOWERED_if: fraction of 50 k = 6 plants whose p_self ranks <= 0.01 against the 300 control-2 p_self values < 0.8
UNDERPOWERED_effect: POSITIVE may still be reported; NEGATIVE and INCONCLUSIVE may not relabel any row to Tier 4
NEGATIVE_consequence: even a valid, powered NEGATIVE supports only 'not distinguishable from numerology for strong effects' (Pablo decides any Tier 4 relabel)
report_only: control 2 one-sample KS (reference set, not a gate)
Z_S and p for S (21 rows)
the v2 hit flag H_T2 for every unit
